title: SISO Foundry Agency OS coverage inventory

license.reason: The Foundry software and authored Agency coverage package are MIT licensed; upstream repositories and external data-plane assets retain their own rights.

evidence.summary: The MIT source license resolves at the exact Agency coverage release commit.

addressable.reason: The Agency coverage package and GitHub release are pinned to an exact public commit.

evidence.summary: The public v0.5.1 release resolves at the canonical job-level coverage revision.

archive_downloadable.reason: The public code and intelligence package have a commit-scoped source archive; operational corpus payloads remain outside Git.

manifest_resolvable.reason: The coverage inventory is machine-readable and carries project-level pillars, evidence grades, reusable-analysis fields, source receipts, and proof boundaries.

evidence.summary: The inventory records 628 unique projects, 12 canonical Agency pillars, 89 source-read or confirmed projects, 10 confirmed projects, and explicit metadata-versus-runtime boundaries.

installable.reason: The repository gate validates the coverage generator, campaign contract, job-level pillar map, source receipts, deterministic outputs, and publication safety.

evidence.summary: Thirty-one Python files compiled, four tests passed, the coverage artifacts regenerated deterministically, and the publication scan passed.

forkable.reason: The source, coverage generator, job-level pillar map, campaign contract, decision tranche, and verifier are public and MIT licensed.

evidence.summary: The human-readable coverage report explains the project inventory, pillar counts, evidence depth, reusable-analysis boundary, and remaining integration-proof gap.

portable.reason: The coverage contract and publication-safe evidence are portable; the larger operational corpus remains externally stored and unreleased.

evidence.summary: The release publishes coverage decisions and source receipts without copying databases, raw observations, client data, private topology, or upstream source trees.

Foundry v0.5.1 publishes deterministic Agency coverage over 628 projects: 89 are source-read or confirmed, 10 are adversarial-confirmed, 10 integration proofs are specified, and only one named proof script is runtime-proven.
